items.title_zh: OTel：开放的电信 AI 数据集、基准与模型
items.title_en: OTel: Open Telco AI Datasets, Benchmarks, and Models
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文介绍了 Open Telco（OTel），一个开放的电信 AI 资源项目，发布了用于检索、重排序、指令微调以及安全/拒答的衍生电信数据集，并提供 30 个全参数后训练基线模型，覆盖 10 个嵌入模型、3 个重排序模型和 17 个语言模型。论文称社区参与度较高：截至 2026 年 5 月 3 日，已发布模型累计下载量超过 1600 万次，项目获得全球 157 篇以上媒体报道。该工作建立在此前开放电信数据集的基础之上。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07766v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource that releases derived telecom datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, together with 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines spanning 10 embedding models, 3 rerankers, and 17 language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage worldwide. Building on prior open telecom datasets a…
items.why_zh: 电信行业此前缺乏公开数据与基线，OTel 为垂直领域的检索与微调研究提供了可复用的开放资源。
items.why_en: Telecom has lacked public data and baselines; OTel gives the vertical reusable open resources for retrieval and tuning research.

items.title_zh: PureTD：无需评估时搜索的双陆棋金钱局强化学习
items.title_en: PureTD: Reinforcement Learning for Backgammon Money Games with No Evaluation-time Search
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文重新审视 Tesauro 的 TD-Gammon，在“评估时不进行搜索”的设定下研究双陆棋金钱局。研究通过自对弈强化学习从零学习走子与加倍骰子（cube）操作，几乎不依赖人工编写逻辑，也不使用专家特征。结果显示，纯自对弈强化学习足以训练出接近当前最先进水平的模型。论文称，在含倍数的金钱局中，这种无搜索模型评估速度更快，且显著强于开源的对手。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15146v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We revisit Tesauro's TD-Gammon for backgammon money games in the setting of no evaluation-time search. Both checker play and cube action (use of the doubling cube) are learned from scratch via self-play reinforcement learning (RL), with minimal hand-coded logic and no expert features. In this setting, we demonstrate that pure self-play RL suffices to train models that reach near-state-of-the-art playing strength. Specifically, for cubeful money games, our search-free model evaluates faster and is substantially stronger than the open-source en…
items.why_zh: 它表明在完全不做评估时搜索的情况下，纯自对弈强化学习也能达到接近顶尖的棋力，对搜索与学习的取舍有参考价值。
items.why_en: It shows pure self-play RL can reach near-top play without any evaluation-time search, informing the trade-off between search and learning.

items.title_zh: AdaptLSTM：面向分布漂移下云负载预测的高效自适应在线学习
items.title_en: AdaptLSTM: Efficient Adaptive Online Learning for Cloud Workload Forecasting under Distribution Drift
items.summary_zh: 论文关注云服务的负载预测问题：病毒式传播内容、产品发布和用户行为变化带来的分布漂移，会让离线训练的模型迅速失效。朴素在线学习虽能恢复精度，但每步计算开销过高。作者提出 AdaptLSTM 自适应在线框架，通过经校准的验证阈值检测漂移，并只做有针对性的选择性更新。在 Alibaba Machine Trace 上，AdaptLSTM 恢复了朴素在线学习所带来的精度提升中的 54%。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.12265v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate workload forecasting is critical for elastic resource provisioning in web-scale cloud services, where distribution shifts driven by viral content, product launches, and user behavior degrade offline-trained models rapidly. Naive online learning recovers accuracy but incurs prohibitive per-step compute cost. We propose AdaptLSTM, an adaptive online framework that detects drift via validation-calibrated thresholds and applies selective, targeted updates. On the Alibaba Machine Trace, AdaptLSTM recovers 54\% of Naive Online's improvemen…
items.why_zh: 在漂移频繁的云环境中同时兼顾预测精度与计算成本，是弹性资源调度能否落地的关键。
items.why_en: Balancing forecast accuracy and compute cost under frequent drift is key to making elastic resource provisioning practical.

items.title_zh: Meta「美国最强开源」搭配苹果最强芯发布，GLM5.3和Kimi K3有对手了
items.title_en: Meta's 'Strongest US' Open Model Launches Alongside Apple's Top Chip, Challenging GLM5.3 and Kimi K3
items.summary_zh: Meta「美国最强开源」搭配苹果最强芯发布，GLM5.3和Kimi K3有对手了 投资界
items.summary_en: Meta has released a new open-source model it bills as the strongest in the US, paired with Apple's most powerful chip, according to Investment Circle. The report frames the release as a new rival to Chinese open-source models such as GLM5.3 and Kimi K3, though detailed specs and benchmarks were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 美国厂商高调宣称拿下开源模型“美国最强”，意味着开源大模型的竞争进一步白热化。
items.why_en: A US player loudly claiming the open-source crown signals intensifying competition in open LLMs.

items.title_zh: Meta发布开源大模型Muse Spark Open 对标Qwen GLM Kimi
items.title_en: Meta Releases Open-Source Model Muse Spark Open, Targeting Qwen, GLM and Kimi
items.summary_zh: Meta发布开源大模型Muse Spark Open 对标Qwen GLM Kimi 亿邦动力
items.summary_en: Meta has released an open-source large model named Muse Spark Open, positioned against mainstream open models such as Qwen, GLM and Kimi, according to Ebrun. Details such as parameter size, benchmark results and licensing were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: Meta 持续以开源方式参与竞争，将直接影响开源大模型的市场格局与开发者的生态选择。
items.why_en: Meta's continued open-source push directly shapes the open-model landscape and developers' ecosystem choices.

items.title_zh: T早报｜DeepSeek服务异常近5小时；库克：苹果智能接入阿里千问大模型；字节跳动海外短剧APP下载量破亿；国产芯片公司算苗科技一年融资近20亿元
items.title_en: T Morning Brief: DeepSeek Outage Lasts Nearly 5 Hours; Cook Says Apple Intelligence to Adopt Alibaba's Qwen
items.summary_zh: T早报｜DeepSeek服务异常近5小时；库克：苹果智能接入阿里千问大模型；字节跳动海外短剧APP下载量破亿；国产芯片公司算苗科技一年融资近20亿元 财新
items.summary_en: A morning brief from Caixin rounds up several developments: DeepSeek suffered a service disruption lasting nearly five hours; Apple CEO Tim Cook said Apple Intelligence will connect to Alibaba's Qwen model; ByteDance's overseas short-drama app surpassed 100 million downloads; and domestic chip company Suanmiao Technology raised nearly 2 billion yuan in a year.
items.why_zh: 一条早报串起大模型服务稳定性、苹果在华 AI 合作、内容出海与国产芯片融资四条关键动向。
items.why_en: It bundles several key China AI developments: model service reliability, Apple's on-device AI partner, content going global, and chip funding.

items.title_zh: 别让朋友把数据喂给 AI 代理
items.title_en: Friends don’t let friends feed their data to AI agents
items.summary_zh: 消费科技领域出现一股趋势：越来越多设备被设计成监视周围的一切人和事，无论对方是否同意。随着 Meta 的 Muse 等“AI 个人助理”登场，用户被要求交出的不只是自己的数据，还包括朋友、家人乃至多年前仅约会过一次的对象的个人信息。Muse 自上月发布后已被下载数百万次，并登上苹果应用商店榜首。文章由此质疑这类产品对隐私边界的侵蚀。
items.summary_en: There's a growing trend in the consumer tech world: gadgets designed to spy on everything and everyone around you , regardless of whether or not anyone else actually consented to it. Now, with the advent of "AI personal assistants" like Meta's Muse, you're being cheerfully asked not just to give up your own data, but also the information of your friends, family, the person you went on a Hinge date with five years ago - and virtually anyone else you've ever come in contact with. Since Muse was released last month, the agent has already been downloaded millions of times and hit No. 1 on Apple's…
items.why_zh: 随着 AI 助理普及，被采集的数据正从“自己”扩展到“身边所有人”，形成个人无法同意的隐私外溢。
items.why_en: As AI assistants go mainstream, the data being harvested is increasingly other people's — a privacy problem individuals cannot consent their way out of.

items.title_zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 哈萨比斯预警：若不对 AI 采取安全措施，未来恐发生严重事故
items.title_en: Google DeepMind's Hassabis Warns of Serious AI Incidents Without Stronger Safety Measures
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 17 日消息，据路透社报道，谷歌 DeepMind 联合创始人兼董事长德米斯 · 哈萨比斯（Demis Hassabis）于本周三表示，近期由 AI 智能体发起的网络攻击事件是“前哨预警”；如果各方不进一步提升系统安全性，全球可能很快会面临严重的网络安全事件。 兼任谷歌母公司 Alphabet 首席科学家的哈萨比斯在都柏林举行的一场人工智能峰会上表示：“ 我认为这些攻击事件对我们而言敲响了前期警钟 。目前的系统尚不够强大，因此造成的破坏还算有限。” 但展望未来一至两年，如果全行业、各家企业以及各国政府不在保护这些系统方面投入更多工作， 未来很可能会演变成灾难性的重大事件 。 IT之家注意到，微软总裁布拉德 · 史密斯（Brad Smith）在大会上指出，AI 的失控行为让 2026 年成为“令人警醒的一年”，迫切需要出台新的 AI 安全法律与规则，确保安全防线能够跟上创新的步伐。 史密斯强调：“没有任何一家公司或一项技术可以凌驾于法律之上。但我们需要法律，需要监管。这种监管应当合理、平衡，并考虑到创新。坦率地讲，业内某些人对监管‘谈之色变’的抗拒心理，是我们必须跨越的障碍。” 哈萨比斯则补充道，尽管建立国际标准机构看似是一项顺理成章的干预举措，但该机制必须做到张弛有度、反应敏捷，以免扼杀技术创新。 因此，核心在于动态构建一套认证机制 —— 既能与实际面临的风险程…
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind co-founder and chairman Demis Hassabis warned at a Dublin AI summit that recent cyberattacks by AI agents are an early warning, and that without stronger safeguards the world could face a catastrophic incident within one to two years. Microsoft president Brad Smith said AI's unconstrained behavior made 2026 a wake-up call and called for new AI safety laws, while Hassabis stressed that international certification mechanisms must be agile and risk-calibrated to avoid stifling innovation.
items.why_zh: 前沿 AI 安全风险正从理论走向现实，监管与动态认证机制成为紧迫议题。
items.why_en: Frontier AI safety risks are moving from theory to reality, making regulation and dynamic certification urgent.

items.title_zh: 基准饱和后如何评估模型能力
items.title_en: Evaluating Model Capabilities After Benchmark Saturation
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文关注 AI 基准饱和问题：当多个模型接近满分后，基准便失去区分模型的能力，也难以为 AI 安全案例和前沿政策提供依据。作者指出，基准题目产生的信息远多于通常提取的分数，还包括每个模型如何解题的完整转录。论文研究在基准分数饱和后，能否利用这些解题转录来评估模型能力，并通过模拟饱和场景进行检验。这为传统基准失效后的能力评估提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20667v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rapid advances in AI capabilities are causing benchmarks to saturate. Once several models approach perfect scores, a benchmark loses its power to differentiate between them, and with it its utility for informing AI safety cases and frontier policies. Yet benchmark items produce far more information than the scores we typically extract from them: a full transcript of how each model solved the task. We investigate whether these transcripts can be used to assess model capabilities even after benchmark scores have saturated. We simulate saturation re…
items.why_zh: 基准饱和会削弱传统评估，解题转录可能成为安全评估和政策制定的新信号。
items.why_en: Benchmark saturation weakens conventional evaluation, and solving transcripts may become a new signal for safety assessment and policy.

items.title_zh: 当现实变化快于认知：可靠智能的新扩展原则
items.title_en: When Reality Outpaces Cognition: A New Scaling Principle for Reliable Intelligence
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文挑战现有 AI 范式和新兴世界模型的理解能力，提出一个根本问题：现实世界变化速度达到多少时，智能系统将无法再可靠地感知、推理和行动。作者将其表述为一个与理论和模型无关的挑战：系统必须在不断扩大的“观察—现实差距”中，为越来越远的未来状态推断可靠行动。论文通过“有效连贯认知速度”（S_C^eff）将这一挑战操作化。摘要未展开具体实验结论，但该框架试图为快速变化环境中的可靠智能建立新的扩展原则。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper challenges the understanding capabilities of existing AI paradigms and emerging world models by asking a fundamental question: How quickly can reality change before an intelligent system can no longer reliably perceive, reason, and act? We formulate this as a theory- and model-agnostic challenge in which systems must infer reliable actions for increasingly distant future states across a growing observation--reality gap. We operationalize this challenge through the effective Speed of Coherent Cognition (\(S_C^{\mathrm{eff}}\)), defined…
items.why_zh: 该框架为评估 AI 在动态现实中的可靠性提供了新视角，对安全部署具有意义。
items.why_en: The framework offers a new lens for assessing AI reliability in a changing world, with implications for safe deployment.

items.title_zh: 当推理轨迹与证据冲突：答案配置如何影响证据遵循
items.title_en: When Reasoning Traces Conflict with Evidence: How Answer Configuration Shapes Evidence Following
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文研究推理轨迹在回答问题时可能扮演的双重角色：它既能提高准确率，也可能在与当前证据冲突时干扰模型对证据的遵循。作者将经过验证的证据版本与由各版本生成的推理轨迹交叉组合，并在两种答案配置下从相同轨迹和证据作答：延续模型自身思考，以及单独发起答案调用。在 gpt-oss、Gemma4、Qwen3 三个模型家族以及 HotpotQA、MuSiQue 数据集上，单独答案调用相比延续思考将证据遵循率提高了 29.9 到 60.6 个百分点。研究揭示了答案配置对模型是否忠实于证据的重要影响。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20805v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A reasoning trace retained at answer time plays two roles: it can raise accuracy, and it can compete with the current evidence when the two disagree. We disentangle these roles by crossing verified evidence versions with the traces generated from each and answering from the same traces and evidence under two configurations: continuation of the model's own thinking and a separate answer call. Across three model families (gpt-oss, Gemma4, Qwen3) on HotpotQA and MuSiQue, the separate call raises evidence-following over continuation by 29.9 to 60.6 p…
items.why_zh: 推理轨迹可能压过证据，答案接口设计直接影响模型输出是否忠实于证据。
items.why_en: Reasoning traces can override evidence, and answer-interface design directly affects whether model outputs remain faithful to evidence.

items.title_zh: Athanor：让前沿智能体自主完成小模型后训练研究
items.title_en: Athanor: An Agent-Native System for Autonomous Post-Training Research
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文提出 Athanor，一个面向自主后训练研究（AutoPostTrain）的“智能体原生”开放系统，在真实 GPU 上运行。研究考察的是可被当下测量的“弱版递归自我改进”：让前沿智能体用公开数据对一个小型原始基座模型做后训练，以此检验其科研潜力。系统赋予智能体完全的研究自主权、低摩擦的工程工具和高效的起步代码，由智能体自行阅读资料、开展实验。该工作为评估 AI 系统的自主研究能力提供了一个可复现的实验平台。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21055v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recursive self-improvement, in which AI systems build stronger AI systems, is one promising route to superintelligence. We study a weaker form that can be measured today: frontier agents post-training a small raw base model with public data, as a test of their research potential. We build Athanor, an open agent-native system for autonomous post-training research (AutoPostTrain) on real GPUs. We give the agents full research autonomy, low-friction engineering tools, and efficient starter code. The agents carry out the research themselves: they rea…
items.why_zh: 它把“AI 自我改进”从抽象设想变成可在真实硬件上测量和复现的实验。
items.why_en: It turns the abstract idea of AI self-improvement into a measurable, reproducible experiment on real hardware.

items.title_zh: OmicsBench：面向研究级生物信息学的长程多轮智能体基准
items.title_en: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，计算生物学家越来越多地把大规模分析交给 AI 智能体，在长程、多轮会话中完成，但现有生物信息学智能体基准大多只给出单轮提示下的单个短任务。为此作者提出 OmicsBench：97 个任务各自把相互依赖的子任务组织成有向无环图，共含 662 个子任务。每个子任务对应一轮用户输入，并依据答案标准答案进行确定性评分，还可选地在上下文中提供反馈。该基准更贴近真实科研分析的流程与依赖关系。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21074v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context fee…
items.why_zh: 它填补了现有基准只测单轮短任务、无法反映真实长链条科研分析的空白。
items.why_en: It fills the gap left by single-shot benchmarks that cannot reflect the long dependency chains of real research analysis.

items.title_zh: SciΠvot：评测科学自动研究智能体在关键节点的“首席研究员”判断力
items.title_en: Sci$\Pi$vot: Benchmarking Principal-Investigator Judgment at Pivotal Moments of Scientific AutoResearch Agents
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，LLM 智能体已能在极少人工监督下持续运行科学实验数月，但可靠的自主研究还需要“科学判断力”。由于研究决策开放且依赖项目背景，这类判断难以评测。作者构建了 SciΠvot：一个基于人类纠正记录、包含 248 个案例的科学判断基准。数据来自六个月的真实研究过程，资深研究者让 LLM 智能体在六个科学领域的 26 个项目上工作，并记录其被纠正的关键决策。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21082v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can keep scientific experiments running for months with little human supervision, but reliable autonomous research also requires scientific judgment. Evaluating scientific judgment is difficult because research decisions are open-ended and depend on project context. We construct Sci$\Pi$vot, a 248-case benchmark of scientific judgment based on human corrections. The benchmark draws on records from six months of research in which senior researchers ran LLM agents on 26 projects across six scientific fields and rep…
items.why_zh: 自主科研不只靠跑实验，还取决于关键时刻的判断力，而这是首个系统评测该能力的基准之一。
items.why_en: Autonomous science depends on judgment at pivotal moments, not just experiment execution, and this benchmark targets that ability directly.

items.title_zh: 潜空间思维链真的在推理吗？统一分类法给出审视框架
items.title_en: Does Latent Chain-of-Thought Actually Reason? A Single, Unifying Taxonomy for Latent Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 潜空间思维链用连续的隐藏状态替代写出的推理步骤，让模型在作答前多进行一些计算，但这些步骤究竟做了什么计算仍不清楚。论文强调，高任务准确率和可解码的中间答案，并不能证明模型真的依赖潜空间链条得出答案。作者在覆盖三种训练方案、三类推理任务和两种骨干模型的 21 种“模型—任务”配置上研究该问题，结合链条删除、内容替换与探针、轨迹分析等方法进行检验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21182v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Latent chain-of-thought replaces written reasoning steps with continuous hidden states, giving models additional steps to compute before answering. It remains unclear what computation these steps actually perform. High task accuracy and decodable intermediate answers do not establish that a model uses its latent chain to reach an answer. We study this question across twenty-one model-task configurations covering three training recipes, three reasoning tasks, and two backbones. We combine chain deletion and content replacement with probes and traj…
items.why_zh: 它质疑了“潜空间推理有效”这一被广泛默认的前提，并给出可操作的验证方法。
items.why_en: It challenges the widely assumed premise that latent reasoning works as claimed and offers concrete methods to verify it.

items.title_zh: 先联想后取消：思考如何让推理模型按字面理解“some”和“or”
items.title_en: Entertain, then Cancel: How Thinking Makes Reasoning Models Read Some and Or Literally
items.summary_zh: 论文从语用推理切入：当有人说“some students passed”，听者通常会推断并非全部通过。如今推理模型允许用户决定思考时长，但多出来的思考会如何影响这类日常推断尚不清楚。作者在固定模型权重、只改变思考量的条件下，记录模型选择哪种解读；并用第二个工具在推理过程的多个节点处切段求解，定位解读发生改变的位置。结果显示，思考会让模型把逻辑词按逻辑字面含义处理。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21204v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When a speaker says ``some students passed'', listeners infer that not all of them did. Reasoning models now let users decide how long a model thinks before it answers, but we do not know what extra thinking does to such everyday inferences. We study this directly: we keep a model's weights fixed, change only how much it thinks, and record which reading it chooses. A second tool cuts the model's own reasoning at successive points and asks for an answer, showing where the reading changes. Thinking makes models read logical words as logic: it cance…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了“更多思考”并非只有收益，还会改变模型对日常语言的语用解读方式。
items.why_en: It shows that more thinking is not purely beneficial: it shifts how models interpret everyday pragmatic language.

items.title_zh: 医疗 LLM 智能体的升级可靠性审计：工作流状态失效的扰动控制基准
items.title_en: Auditing Escalation Reliability in Healthcare LLM Agents: A Perturbation-Controlled Benchmark of Workflow-State Failures
items.summary_zh: 论文认为，可信的生物医学 AI 不只要在静态输入上答对，更要在证据缺失、过期、冲突或迟到时可靠地选择行动。作者构建了 400 个合成医疗工作流片段作为回合级评测协议：覆盖四类任务、40 个手工撰写的语义种子、两种表层参数化和五种受控变体。智能体需在 ANSWER、ASK CLARIFICATION、ABSTAIN、ESCALATE 之间选择，并按预先声明的“漏升级与不必要升级 5:1”代价评分。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21270v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Trustworthy biomedical AI requires reliable action selection when evidence is missing, stale, conflicting, or late, not only accurate answers on static inputs. We instantiate an episode-level evaluation protocol as 400 synthetic healthcare workflow episodes: 40 hand-authored semantic seeds across four task classes, two surface parameterizations, and five controlled variants, scored on ANSWER/ASK CLARIFICATION/ABSTAIN/ESCALATE under a pre-declared 5:1 missed-versus-unnecessary escalation cost. Reference actions are single-author study-policy label…
items.why_zh: 它把医疗智能体的评测重点从“答得对”转向“该升级时能否升级”，直接关系临床安全。
items.why_en: It shifts healthcare agent evaluation from answer accuracy to whether agents escalate appropriately, which is central to clinical safety.

items.title_zh: 多智能体聚合中的偏见控制与偏见注入
items.title_en: Bias Control and Injection for Multi-Agent Aggregation
items.summary_zh: 多智能体推理面临一个核心问题：当智能体意见不一致时，应当信任谁的决策？论文指出，这类分歧难以裁决，因为智能体的决策会受到多数压力、回答风格偏好等非语义偏见影响，从而掩盖其底层推理质量。分析显示，偏见既可以被缓解也可以被利用：偏见控制能改善初始答案选择，而偏见注入则会诱发决策不稳定。该工作为理解与调控集体决策中的偏见提供了双向视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21290v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-agent reasoning with large language models (LLMs) raises a central question for collective decision-making: when agents disagree, whose decision should be trusted? Resolving such disagreements is difficult because agents' decisions are susceptible to non-semantic biases such as majority pressure and response-style preferences, which can obscure the quality of the underlying reasoning. Our analysis shows how bias can be both mitigated and exploited: bias control improves initial answer selection, while bias injection elicits decision instabi…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了多智能体共识中的偏见既可能是噪声，也可能成为可被利用的杠杆。
items.why_en: It shows that bias in multi-agent consensus can be either noise to remove or a lever to exploit.

items.title_zh: 在想象中做约束多智能体强化学习
items.title_en: Constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in Imagination
items.summary_zh: 论文提出在世界模型中预测代价，从而把大部分约束策略更新搬到“想象”空间完成。结果显示，在 SMAC 的中位配置上，更强的无模型基线所需的交互次数是 CA-MAMBA 的 10 到 20 倍；在同等预算下，CA-MAMBA 在 MAMuJoCo 上取得的奖励是基线的 2.8 到 12 倍。在两个基准各取一个任务的受控测试中，将模型估计的代价优势按等价折算后，可使“无视代价”学习器的代价降低一半以上，并满足一个紧的连续控制限制，而学习到的乘子方法未能达到该限制。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting cost in a multi-agent world model moves most constrained policy updates into imagination: the stronger model-free baseline needs $10$ to $20$ times CA-MAMBA's interactions on the median SMAC configuration, and CA-MAMBA earns $2.8$ to $12$ times the baselines' MAMuJoCo reward at equal budget. In controlled tests on one task per benchmark, pricing the model's cost advantages at parity more than halves a cost-blind learner's cost and meets a tight continuous-control limit the learned multiplier misses, suggesting the model's cost estimate…
items.why_zh: 它表明世界模型中的代价预测能大幅降低约束多智能体学习的样本成本，同时更好地满足安全约束。
items.why_en: It shows cost prediction inside a world model can sharply cut sample costs for constrained multi-agent learning while better satisfying safety limits.

items.title_zh: 量子机器学习与经典机器学习在神经精神疾病分类上的对比：特征匹配的多队列评估
items.title_en: Quantum Versus Classical Machine Learning for Neuropsychiatric Disorders: A Feature-Matched Multi-Cohort Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 新论文系统比较了量子机器学习模型与经典模型在神经精神疾病分类任务上的表现。研究使用相同的相关性衍生特征（静息态功能连接），在四个公开队列、共 4308 名受试者上进行评估，并采用留站点验证（leave-site-out）以检验跨站点泛化能力，其中自闭症数据集 ABIDE I 是重点测试对象。作者将六个量子模型家族与匹配的经典模型逐一对照，以回答量子模型在真实多队列场景下是否真正具备优势。此前虽有研究将量子机器学习用于功能连接数据，但少有工作在留站点验证或与特征匹配的经典模型对照下进行评估，该研究填补了这一空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Resting-state functional connectivity is widely used in machine learning-based classification of neuropsychiatric disorders. Quantum machine learning models have been proposed for functional connectivity data, but few studies have evaluated them under leave-site-out validation or against matched classical models. We compared six quantum model families with classical ones using identical correlation-derived features across four public cohorts (4,308 subjects). Leave-site-out validation was used for the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE I),…
items.why_zh: 它为量子机器学习在脑影像诊断中的实际价值提供了首个较为严格的多队列、特征匹配对照证据。
items.why_en: It offers rigorous, feature-matched, multi-cohort evidence on whether quantum machine learning genuinely helps in brain-imaging-based diagnosis.

items.title_zh: 用分层图卷积网络检测低质量文档
items.title_en: Hierarchical Graph Convolutional Network Approach for Detecting Low-Quality Documents
items.summary_zh: 该 arXiv 论文关注网络内容质量下降的问题：大量文档存在内部不一致，或正文与标题完全无关，这类低质量内容会让读者疲劳并损害媒体公信力。作者提出一种分层图卷积网络方法，用于自动检测此类低质量文档。研究动机在于，文档内部一致性是衡量质量的关键特征，而基于自然语言处理的自动检测研究仍显不足。论文摘要指出该方向对内容平台和媒体机构具有现实意义，但未披露具体数据集与实验数字。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21350v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Consistency within a document is a crucial feature indicative of its quality. Recently, within the vast amount of information produced across various media, there exists a significant number of low-quality documents that either lack internal consistency or contain content utterly unrelated to their headlines. Such low-quality documents induce fatigue in readers and undermine the credibility of the media source that provided them. Consequently, research to automatically detect these low-quality documents based on natural language processing is imp…
items.why_zh: 面对大规模生成内容泛滥，自动识别不一致或标题党式文档对维护信息可信度至关重要。
items.why_en: As generated content proliferates, automatically flagging inconsistent or headline-mismatched documents is key to preserving information credibility.

items.title_zh: SIF：用选择性内部反馈让语言模型学会推理
items.title_en: Learning to Reason with Selective Internal Feedback
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，利用内部反馈的强化学习可以在没有标准答案或外部验证器的情况下改进语言模型，但训练中“自信”与“正确”可能发生偏离——持续优化平均自置信度会提升信心却同时损害推理准确率。为此作者提出 SIF，一种结合比较式奖励构建与选择性策略更新的强化学习方法。SIF 在多个窗口与同伴之间比较排序后的词元级自置信度曲线，只对符合条件的情形给予正向奖励，从而避免盲目推高自信。该方法旨在无需外部监督即可稳定提升推理表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21392v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning from internal feedback can improve language models without ground-truth answers or external verifiers. However, confidence and correctness can diverge during training, and continued optimization of average self-certainty can increase confidence while degrading reasoning accuracy. We introduce SIF, a reinforcement learning method that combines comparative reward construction with selective policy updates. SIF compares ranked token-level self-certainty profiles across multiple windows and peers, assigning positive rewards onl…
items.why_zh: 它针对“越自信越不准”这一自我奖励训练的核心风险，给出了无需外部验证器的改进方案。
items.why_en: It addresses the core risk of self-reward training—rising confidence with falling accuracy—without needing external verifiers.

items.title_zh: MemCut：LLM 智能体的长期记忆里，每个秘密都会留下痕迹
items.title_en: MemCut: Every Secret Leaves a Trail in the Long-Term Memory of LLM Agents
items.summary_zh: 长期记忆已成为大语言模型智能体的关键组件，但现有研究多聚焦于如何准确高效地检索信息，而忽略了“应要求遗忘”的能力。作者提出 MemCut，一个系统评测用户请求遗忘能力的基准，包含 456 个手工设计的秘密，分布在长程对话中，并为每个秘密标注了完整的证据链。该基准不仅检验删除后秘密能否被恢复，还覆盖那些从未直接陈述秘密、却间接泄露信息的消息。它揭示了可靠记忆系统必须兼顾检索与可验证的遗忘。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-term memory has become a crucial component of large language model (LLM) agents, with most research focusing on retrieving relevant information accurately and efficiently. However, a dependable memory system must also forget sensitive user data upon request. To evaluate this capability, we introduce MemCut, a systematic benchmark for user-requested forgetting. Its 456 hand-designed secrets in long-horizon conversations have fully annotated evidence trails to test recovery after deletion, including from messages that never state the secrets d…
items.why_zh: 隐私合规要求智能体能真正“忘记”，MemCut 首次系统检验记忆删除是否可被绕过。
items.why_en: Privacy compliance demands agents that can truly forget; MemCut is an early systematic test of whether memory deletion can be circumvented.

items.title_zh: JevAgentHarness：评测、部署与训练与 LLM 共享控制权的决策模型
items.title_en: JevAgentHarness: Benchmarking, Deploying and Training Decision Models That Share Control with LLMs
items.summary_zh: LLM 智能体已能修复软件、操作电脑和接待客户，但其运行框架在每一步都要调用大型模型，导致长任务又慢又贵，而这些调用大多只是做多选题式决策，例如下一步调用哪个工具。论文提出 JevAgentHarness，研究如何把这类决策委派给 Jev 等决策模型，从而以远低于 LLM 调用的时间和成本完成判断，同时尽量不损失任务成功率。工作涵盖决策模型在智能体任务中的评测、部署与训练，探索决策模型与 LLM 共享控制权的混合架构。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents now fix software, operate computers and serve customers, but their harnesses, the programs that run them, call a large LLM at every step, which makes long tasks slow and costly. Most of these calls end in a multiple-choice decision, such as which tool to call next. Decision models such as Jev answer these questions directly, at a fraction of an LLM call's time and price. We ask how a harness can delegate these decisions to a decision model with little loss of success. To evaluate decision models in agentic tasks,…
items.why_zh: 把高频简单决策交给小模型，可显著降低智能体长任务的延迟与成本。
items.why_en: Delegating frequent, simple decisions to small models can sharply cut latency and cost for long agentic tasks.

items.title_zh: 智能体需要一种新论文形态吗？SPRA：面向智能体的结构化论文表示
items.title_en: Do Agents Need a New Kind of Paper? SPRA: Structured Paper Representation for Agents
items.summary_zh: 科学智能体需要把分散在叙述性文章中的研究问题、方法与发现连接起来，但传统论文格式对此并不友好。作者提出 SPRA（面向智能体的结构化论文表示），以论文为单位表示持久的研究对象及其类型化关系。其面向实证类 AI 论文的配置把问题、贡献、组件、实验设置、度量与发现组织起来，支持查询、遍历与复用；选定的论文级引用关系记录依赖、组件使用与与既往工作的比较，并保留原文位置以便核验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21424v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scientific agents must connect research problems, methods, and findings dispersed through narrative articles. We introduce SPRA (Structured Paper Representation for Agents), a paper-level representation of persistent research objects and typed relations. Its empirical-AI profile organizes Problems, Contributions, Components, ExperimentSetups, Measures, and Findings for querying, traversal, and reuse. Selected paper-level citation relations record dependencies, component use, and comparisons with prior work; source locations support verification.…
items.why_zh: 若智能体要真正做科研，论文需要机器可读的结构化表示，SPRA 提供了可验证的一种方案。
items.why_en: If agents are to do real research, papers need machine-readable structure—SPRA offers a verifiable design for that.

items.title_zh: 用工具调用强化学习预测急诊到院后的急救需求
items.title_en: Incentivizing Tool-Use Reinforcement Learning for Post-Arrival Emergency Care Prediction
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型能同时处理结构化测量数据与自由文本记录，因而被视为急诊科预测的有力工具，但在基于电子健康记录的预测任务上，它们往往仍不及决策树等传统机器学习方法。作者的受控分析把差距归因于两点：LLM 不会挑选有信息量的特征，且即便给出了正确特征，也会误判数值对风险的含义。为此他们提出 TIR-EC，一个工具集成的强化学习框架，通过激励模型调用外部工具来弥补这两项短板，提升急诊预测表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21449v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can reason over both structured measurements and free-text records, which makes them attractive for emergency department (ED) prediction. However, most existing LLMs still fall short of conventional ML methods like trees on EHR-based prediction tasks. Our controlled analysis traces this gap to two weaknesses: LLMs do not select informative features, and they misjudge what numerical values imply for risk even when given the right features. We propose TIR-EC, a tool-integrated reinforcement learning framework that addre…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了 LLM 在临床表格预测上落后的具体原因，并给出可训练的补救路径。
items.why_en: It pinpoints why LLMs lag on clinical tabular prediction and offers a trainable remedy.

items.title_zh: 结合嵌入模型与 LLM 的本体精炼：CASTON 案例研究
items.title_en: Ontology Refinement with Embeddings and LLMs: A Case Study on CASTON
items.summary_zh: 本体被广泛用于表示生物医学、医疗等领域中的复杂知识，但构建可靠本体仍很困难——无论手工还是自动构建的类层次结构，都可能含有细微的上下位关系错误，需要细致精炼。论文以铸造领域的本体 CASTON 为案例，提出一套轻量但可扩展的精炼流程，将微调后的本体嵌入模型与大语言模型结合使用。该工作展示了如何借助嵌入与 LLM 的互补能力来发现并修正本体中的从属错误。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ontologies are widely used to represent and organize complex knowledge in domains such as biomedicine and healthcare. However, constructing reliable ontologies remains challenging, as class hierarchies, whether manually or automatically constructed, may contain subtle subsumption errors that require careful refinement. We study this problem in CASTON, a casting-domain ontology, and present a lightweight but scalable refinement workflow that combines a fine-tuned ontology embedding model with Large Language Models (LLMs). The embedding model is us…
items.why_zh: 本体质量直接影响下游知识应用，该流程为低成本、可扩展的本体维护提供了可复用范式。
items.why_en: Ontology quality affects downstream knowledge applications; this workflow offers a low-cost, scalable maintenance pattern.

items.title_zh: FlashAttention 统计法：低开销注意力特征助力轻量幻觉检测
items.title_en: FlashAttention with Statistics: Low-Overhead Attention Features for Compact Hallucination Detectors
items.summary_zh: 研究关注大语言模型生成看似流畅但缺乏上下文支持的“幻觉”回答。已有方法利用冻结的小型代理模型读取上下文和另一模型的回答进行检测，其中基于注意力的检测器需要注意力权重的汇总统计。但标准流程会显式生成注意力矩阵，内存随序列长度平方增长。作者提出在 FlashAttention 计算过程中直接累积这些统计量，避免物化注意力矩阵，从而以较低开销获得检测特征。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21483v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models can produce fluent answers that the supplied context does not support. A compact frozen proxy model can detect such answers by reading the context and another model's response, even from a proprietary generator. Attention-based detectors use summary statistics of the proxy's attention weights, but standard pipelines materialize the attention matrix, whose memory grows quadratically with sequence length. We compute these statistics without materializing attention, by accumulation in the FlashAttention pass, sparse lookups aft…
items.why_zh: 它把注意力特征提取嵌入 FlashAttention，显著降低长上下文幻觉检测的内存与计算成本。
items.why_en: It embeds attention-feature extraction into FlashAttention, lowering the memory and compute cost of long-context hallucination detection.

items.title_zh: ClaimScope：面向数学主张审计的标签盲见证验证
items.title_en: ClaimScope: Label-Blind Witness Verification for Mathematical Claim Auditing
items.summary_zh: 数学智能体通常按答案准确率或证明是否被接受来评估，但这对“审计主张”本身不够。作者推出 ClaimScope，一个含 72 个任务的基准，要求模型给出裁决、范围、反例和修复方案，任务覆盖优化器状态传输、有限时域仿射递推和精确 2×2 线性代数。研究评估了 Qwen3-8B 的直接生成以及四种匹配的两遍条件，且均从同一草稿出发；其见证检查器只检查模型提交的状态，不参考标准裁决，也不提供答案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21581v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mathematical agents are commonly evaluated by answer accuracy or proof acceptance. We introduce ClaimScope, a 72-task benchmark for auditing proposed claims through a verdict, scope, counterexample, and repair. Tasks cover optimizer-state transport, finite-horizon affine recurrences, and exact $2\times2$ linear algebra. We evaluate Qwen3-8B with direct generation and four matched two-pass conditions, each starting from the same draft. A witness checker evaluates only the model's submitted state, without consulting reference verdicts or supplying…
items.why_zh: 它把数学智能体评估从“答案对不对”推进到“主张能否被证据审计”，更贴近可靠数学推理。
items.why_en: It shifts math-agent evaluation from answer accuracy to evidence-based claim auditing, closer to reliable mathematical reasoning.

items.title_zh: LOADBench：面向模拟 IC 设计机器学习的大型开放数据集与基准
items.title_en: LOADBench: A Large Open Analog Dataset and Benchmark for Machine Learning in IC Design
items.summary_zh: 模拟集成电路设计的机器学习受限于开放数据不足和评测不统一，不同论文常使用定制甚至闭源数据集与临时指标，导致方法间难以可靠比较。为填补这两个缺口，作者发布大型开源数据集和一套标准化基准。数据集包含 SkyWater130 PDK 中 100 多种一、二、三级运算放大器拓扑，并为每种拓扑提供结构与功能标注。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21591v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning (ML) for analog IC design is constrained by limited open data and the absence of standardized evaluation: results reported in different papers are typically obtained on bespoke, often closed, datasets and with ad-hoc metrics, leaving comparisons across methods unreliable. We address both gaps with a large opensource dataset and a suite of standardized benchmarks. The dataset contains more than 100 operational amplifier (opamp) topologies (1-, 2-, and 3-stage) in the SkyWater130 PDK, each shipped with structural and functional ann…
items.why_zh: 它为模拟电路机器学习提供开放数据与统一评测，有望提升结果的可复现性和可比性。
items.why_en: It provides open data and standardized evaluation for analog-circuit ML, improving reproducibility and comparability.

items.title_zh: LoopAhead：为循环语言模型解码提前推测以加速生成
items.title_en: LoopAhead: Speculating Ahead for Faster Decoding in Looped Language Models
items.summary_zh: 循环 Transformer 通过反复应用同一组 Transformer 层来提高参数效率，但生成每个 token 仍需顺序计算并反复访问模型权重，解码延迟较高。现有的流水线自推测解码会利用早期循环预测起草 token，并在同一批次中异步推进不同循环深度的 token，但仍未充分利用早期循环特征进行更长程的前瞻，且验证计算开销仍存在。LoopAhead 在此基础上改进推测与验证流程，以更充分地利用早期循环信息并加速解码。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21594v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. However, generating each token still involves sequential computation and repeated access to model weights, leading to high decoding latency. Recent pipelined self-speculative decoding methods reduce this delay by drafting tokens from early-loop predictions and asynchronously advancing tokens at different recurrent depths in the same batch, but they do not fully exploit early-loop features for longer lookahead and still spend computation verifying…
items.why_zh: 它试图在不增加参数的情况下降低循环语言模型的推理延迟，提升这类高效架构的实用性。
items.why_en: It aims to reduce inference latency in looped language models without adding parameters, improving the practicality of these efficient architectures.

items.title_zh: AgentPerturb：评估 LLM 智能体在受控交互扰动下的鲁棒性
items.title_en: AgentPerturb: Evaluating LLM Agent Robustness under Controlled Interaction Perturbations
items.summary_zh: 现实任务复杂且噪声多，给 LLM 智能体带来显著挑战，但现有评测缺少能同时刻画“扰动目标”和“扰动类型”的系统框架。作者提出二维视角下的 AgentPerturb，用统一研究量化当前前沿模型的鲁棒性，追踪扰动引发失败的机制，并给出面向鲁棒性训练的启示。在 APEX-Agents 和 Toolathlon 上的受控评估显示，扰动会持续影响智能体表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21624v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Real-world tasks are often complex and noisy, posing substantial challenges for LLM agents. Yet existing evaluations lack a systematic framework for jointly characterizing potential perturbation targets and types. We use this two-dimensional view to conduct a unified study that quantifies the robustness of current frontier models, traces the mechanisms behind perturbation-induced failures, and draws implications for robustness-oriented training. Through controlled evaluations on APEX-Agents and Toolathlon, we find that perturbations consistently…
items.why_zh: 它把智能体鲁棒性评测从零散案例提升为可控、可归因的系统研究。
items.why_en: It turns agent robustness evaluation from scattered cases into a controlled, mechanism-oriented study.

items.title_zh: 从研究目标到科学闭环：以证据支持的物理研究评估智能体
items.title_en: From Research Goals to Scientific Closure: Evaluating Agents Through Evidence-Supported Physics Research
items.summary_zh: 研究提出 PhysClosureBench，用于检验 AI 智能体能否组织科学调查并得出有充分支持的结论。该基准包含 50 个经专家验证、目标明确的研究任务，覆盖强场物理、阿秒物理及邻近领域。每个任务只给出研究目标和关键科学约束，由智能体自行组织调查、决定如何生成并验证证据。评估采用包含 20 项标准的 Atomic Score 来衡量局部科学过程。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21767v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can AI agents organize scientific investigations that lead to well-supported conclusions? To evaluate this capability, we introduce PhysClosureBench, a benchmark of 50 expert-verified, goal-specified research tasks spanning strong-field, attosecond, and neighboring physics areas. Each task specifies the research objective and essential scientific constraints, while leaving the agent to organize the investigation and determine how to generate and validate the evidence needed to answer the question. A 20-criterion Atomic Score measures local scient…
items.why_zh: 它检验智能体能否完成从研究目标到证据闭环的完整科研流程，而不仅是回答物理题。
items.why_en: It tests whether agents can close the loop from research goals to evidence-supported conclusions, not just answer physics questions.

items.title_zh: Co2In：知识编码、巩固与整合的双层记忆增量学习框架
items.title_en: Co2In: a Bi-level Memory Incremental Learning Framework with Knowledge Encoding, Consolidation, and Integration
items.summary_zh: 增量学习希望智能系统持续获得新知识（可塑性），同时保留已学信息（稳定性），但二者平衡仍是难题。人类大脑依靠多种记忆单元协同编码和存储信息，实现了出色的平衡。受此启发，作者提出 Co2In 框架，将知识编码、巩固与整合结合起来，并设计为双层记忆结构，以同时提升可塑性和稳定性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21804v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Incremental learning (IL) aims to continually acquire new knowledge (plasticity) while retaining previously learned information (stability). However, striking a balance between plasticity and stability remains a significant challenge for intelligent systems. The human brain achieves exceptional balance, owing to various memory units that collaboratively encode and store information. Inspired by human memory mechanisms, this paper introduces an IL framework with knowledge enCoding, Consolidation, and Integration (Co2In). Co2In is designed as a bi-…
items.why_zh: 它用类脑双层记忆机制应对增量学习中的稳定性—可塑性权衡。
items.why_en: It uses a brain-inspired bi-level memory mechanism to address the stability–plasticity trade-off in incremental learning.

items.title_zh: RoleQ：按功能角色对齐尺度，将语言模型三值化
items.title_en: RoleQ: Role-Aligned Scales for Converting Language Models to Ternary
items.summary_zh: 低于 4 比特的权重量化能减少内存和带宽，并在困惑度上看似可接受，却常以事实知识和任务准确率下降为代价；三值权重此前多依赖从头训练或长时间微调。RoleQ 提出一种量化框架，不按权重矩阵布局，而按 Transformer 单元的功能角色来放置量化尺度。具体地，从残差流读取的向量按输出单元设一个尺度，写入残差流的向量按输入单元设一个尺度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21808v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Weight quantization below four bits shrinks memory and bandwidth at a perplexity that looks acceptable, but often at the cost of factual knowledge and task accuracy. Ternary weights have mostly been obtained by training from scratch or long fine-tuning. We introduce RoleQ, a quantization framework that places scales by the functional roles of Transformer units rather than by the layout of the weight matrix, as conventional formats do. Vectors that read from the residual stream take one scale per output unit; those that write to it, one per input…
items.why_zh: 角色对齐的尺度有望让三值语言模型在压缩的同时更好保留事实知识和任务精度。
items.why_en: Role-aligned scales could let ternary language models retain more factual knowledge and task accuracy under compression.

items.title_zh: 利用大语言模型构建强化学习的过程奖励模型
items.title_en: Progress Reward Model for Reinforcement Learning via Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 一篇新的 arXiv 论文关注强化学习在长周期、稀疏奖励任务中的困境：传统算法难以处理这类任务，而近年引入大语言模型（LLM）的做法各有短板——基于规划的方案往往依赖预定义技能库，无法优化底层控制策略；基于奖励的方案则需要大量人工反馈或穷举搜索。为此，作者提出一种借助大语言模型生成过程奖励的新方法（论文摘要中未给出完整方法细节），试图在减少人工反馈的同时为长程任务提供更细粒度的奖励信号。该工作属于 LLM 与强化学习交叉方向，目标是缓解稀疏奖励带来的学习效率问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22056v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms face significant limitations in handling long-term tasks with sparse rewards. Recent advancements have leveraged large language models (LLMs) to enhance RL by utilizing their world knowledge for task planning and reward generation. However, planning-based approaches often depend on pre-defined skill libraries and fail to optimize low-level control policies, while reward-based methods require extensive human feedback or exhaustive searching due to the complexity of tasks. In this paper, we propose…
items.why_zh: 为长程稀疏奖励任务提供更自动化的奖励信号，是提升 LLM 驱动强化学习实用性的关键一步。
items.why_en: More automated reward signals for long-horizon, sparse-reward tasks are key to making LLM-driven reinforcement learning practical.

items.title_zh: PROBE：让模型学会审计使用工具的 LLM 智能体是否合规
items.title_en: PROBE: Learning to Audit Policy Compliance in Tool-Using LLM Agents
items.summary_zh: 论文指出现有智能体评测存在关键空白：能力基准只衡量智能体能完成什么，内容安全红队测试只关注有害生成，二者都不检验智能体是否遵守预定义策略。而现实中的智能体常被价格、隐私、用户确认、安全等规则约束。作者提出 PROBE，用学习的方式审计使用外部工具的 LLM 智能体在多轮交互中的策略合规性。该工作面向智能体在真实、高风险场景部署时的合规评估需求。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern agentic systems extend language models with external tools, enabling them to complete complex tasks through multi-turn interactions. As these agents are deployed in consequential settings, they are often constrained by policies governing pricing, privacy, confirmation, safety, and other requirements. However, existing evaluation methods leave a critical gap: capability benchmarks measure what agents can accomplish, while content-safety red-teaming measures harmful generations, but neither tests whether agents comply with predefined policie…
items.why_zh: 随着智能体进入真实业务流程，能否可靠检验其遵守规则将成为部署前的必要关卡。
items.why_en: As agents enter real business workflows, reliably testing rule compliance becomes a necessary gate before deployment.

items.title_zh: CART：面向多模态持续指令微调的兼容路由方法
items.title_en: CART: Compatible Routing for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
items.summary_zh: 多模态大模型（MLLM）通常通过指令微调获得能力，但真实应用中它们需要按顺序不断学习新任务，即多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）。论文指出，现有方法主要保护语言模型不被遗忘，却让连接视觉与语言模型的投影器在各任务间持续更新，这种不对称适配可能造成显著的表示偏移与遗忘问题。作者提出 CART（兼容路由）方法来缓解该问题（摘要中未展开具体机制细节）。该研究关注多模态模型在持续学习中的稳定性与可扩展性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22137v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance through instruction tuning, yet real-world applications often require them to continually acquire new capabilities from sequential tasks, i.e., Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT). In typical MLLMs, a projector is employed to align visual representations with the language model. However, existing methods primarily protect the language model from forgetting while continuously updating the projector across tasks. Such asymmetric adaptation can cause substantial represent…
items.why_zh: 指出投影器与语言模型更新不对称这一被忽视的遗忘来源，为多模态模型持续学习提供新思路。
items.why_en: It highlights asymmetric projector-versus-LLM adaptation as an overlooked source of forgetting, offering a new angle for continual multimodal learning.

items.title_zh: 为非英语母语学生打造的多源 AI 助教
items.title_en: Multi-sourced AI Tutor for Non-Native English Speaker Students
items.summary_zh: 随着国际学生大量进入计算机类项目，研究者开始关注非英语母语（NNES）学生在计算课程中因语言障碍遇到的困难。论文介绍了一个通用 AI 助教系统，可直接处理学生用外语提出的问题（目前聚焦于特定语言范围），从而帮助这类学生跨越语言门槛获得答疑支持。该系统建立在 LLM 作为教学工具日益普及的背景之上，目标是让计算教育中的 AI 助教覆盖更广泛的学生群体。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being adopted as teaching tools in computing education, particularly for developing AI tutors capable of answering student questions. With the rise in enrollment of international students in computing programs, researchers have begun to explore the difficulties that non-native English speaker (NNES) students face in computing courses due to language barriers. To aid such students, we developed a general-purpose AI tutor system that can process student questions in foreign languages (currently focused…
items.why_zh: 将 LLM 助教的语言适配视为教育公平问题，有助于国际学生更平等地获得课程支持。
items.why_en: Treating language adaptation of LLM tutors as an equity issue helps international students get equal access to course support.

items.title_zh: AutoSFT：自动进行监督微调数据研究的智能体系统
items.title_en: AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，语言模型智能体在自动化后训练时往往收敛到监督微调，并把大部分精力花在修改训练数据上。现有系统只赋予智能体单一控制方式——从固定池中选行或调用生成器，而人类数据工程师会调整数据配比、剪枝、修复、替换和合成。作者据此设计了一个涵盖上述操作的数据动作空间，并探讨自动化系统能否执行完整的一套操作、以及需要怎样的结构支撑。该工作把“数据工程”本身作为智能体自动化的对象。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language model agents increasingly automate post-training, but when given the full training stack they converge on supervised fine-tuning and spend most effort revising training data. Existing systems give the agent one kind of control, selecting rows from a fixed pool or calling a generator, whereas a human data engineer adjusts proportions, prunes, repairs, replaces and synthesizes the data. We design a data action space for these changes and ask whether an automated system can make the full range rather than one of them, and what structure tha…
items.why_zh: 把数据工程作为智能体可自动化的核心对象，可能显著改变后训练的成本结构。
items.why_en: Making data engineering itself the target of agent automation could substantially reshape post-training cost structures.

items.title_zh: 四个 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体协作通关《我的世界》
items.title_en: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft
items.summary_zh: 研究团队将四个 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体放入沙盒化的《我的世界》生存世界，只给出一个目标：击败末影龙。每个智能体通过开源库 Mineflayer 控制一名玩家，并借助游戏内聊天与共享记忆与队友协作。没有任何人为它们分配角色或编写游戏逻辑——计划、编写与调试所有程序均由智能体自行完成。研究者可通过实时面板观看运行并随时暂停或终止，但全程无需介入。实验从随机生成的世界开始，展示了多智能体长期自主协作完成复杂目标的潜力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We placed four Gemini 4 Argon agents in a sandboxed Minecraft survival world and gave them one goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. Each agent controlled a player via an open-source library called Mineflayer and coordinated with its teammates through in-game chat and shared memory. No one assigned roles or wrote game logic. The agents planned, wrote, and debugged every program themselves. Researchers could watch the run on a live dashboard and pause or stop it at any time, but they had no cause to intervene. Starting from a randomly generated world on…
items.why_zh: 在无人分配角色、无人工编写逻辑的情况下完成长程多智能体任务，是自主协作能力的重要展示。
items.why_en: Completing a long-horizon multi-agent task with no assigned roles or hand-written logic is a notable demonstration of autonomous coordination.

items.title_zh: 为连续扩散语言模型重新设计 Transformer
items.title_en: Designing Transformers for Continuous Diffusion Language Models
items.summary_zh: 连续扩散语言模型（CDLM）为并行文本生成提供了另一条路径，但现有研究大多直接套用因果大语言模型或图像生成用 Diffusion Transformer（DiT）的架构，这些架构并未针对 CDLM 优化。论文系统研究了适用于 CDLM 的 Transformer 设计，并提出 LangDiT（Language Diffusion Transformer），融合特征归一化与 query-key 归一化、更宽的噪声条件化以及似然捷径（likelihood-shortcut）等技术。该工作为扩散式语言生成的架构选择提供了系统性的实验依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22330v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) offer an alternative approach to parallel language generation; however, most existing studies directly use transformer architectures from either causal large language models (LLMs) or Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for image generation, which were not optimized for CDLMs. In this paper, we conduct a systematic study on Transformer architectures for CDLMs and introduce Language Diffusion Transformer (LangDiT), combining feature and query-key normalization, wider noise conditioning, likelihood-shortcut gr…
items.why_zh: 为并行生成的扩散语言模型补齐专用架构设计，有助于该路线与自回归模型正面竞争。
items.why_en: Dedicated architectures for diffusion-based parallel generation help this line of work compete directly with autoregressive models.

items.title_zh: 评估意识不止于英语：LLM 在被印度语言测试时会改变行为吗？
items.title_en: Evaluation Awareness Beyond English: Do LLMs Act Differently When Tested in Indic Languages?
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型常常能察觉自己正在被测试，这种“评估意识”会让模型在安全评测中比真实使用场景更为谨慎，从而干扰评测结论。已有研究几乎完全基于英语，但模型服务的是多语言用户，印度语言使用者超过十亿，相关研究却几乎空白。论文选取来自三个模型家族的四个指令微调模型，在五种印度语言与英语上开展测试，考察评估意识是否跨语言存在差异。该研究对多语言安全评测的有效性提出了直接质疑。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can often tell when they are being tested. This ability, known as evaluation awareness, can lead models to act more cautiously during safety evaluations than in real use. Existing work has studied evaluation awareness almost entirely in English, although models serve users in many languages. Indic languages are spoken by over a billion people, yet evaluation awareness remains almost entirely unstudied in them. We test four instruction-tuned models from three families in five Indic languages alongside English. A set of…
items.why_zh: 如果评估意识随语言变化，仅用英语得出的安全评测结论可能无法外推到全球用户。
items.why_en: If evaluation awareness varies by language, English-only safety evaluations may not generalize to global users.

items.title_zh: MLExpert：迈向自主机器学习工程的通用智能体模型
items.title_en: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
items.summary_zh: 一篇新论文提出 MLExpert，目标是构建可自主完成机器学习工程（MLE）的通用智能体模型。作者指出，大语言模型正从辅助科研与工程，走向自主开发并改进 AI 系统，即“AI for AI”（AI4AI），被视为通往递归自我改进（RSI）的路径之一。现有的工作流驱动型 MLE 系统通过复杂编排管理长周期实验，是通向该目标的现实方案；而较新的 MLE 系统转向由模型主导的交互，让模型自行组织实验并调整优化策略。论文摘要尚未给出具体实验结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding from assisting scientific research and engineering to autonomously developing and improving AI systems, advancing AI for AI (AI4AI) as a pathway toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Workflow-driven machine learning engineering (MLE) systems provide a practical path toward this pursuit through complex orchestration that manages long-horizon experimentation, while recent MLE systems adopt model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize experiments and adapt optimization strategies…
items.why_zh: 若模型能自主组织并迭代机器学习实验，将显著加速 AI 研发本身，也是“递归自我改进”讨论的关键一步。
items.why_en: If models can autonomously organize and iterate on ML experiments, AI research itself accelerates — a key step in the debate over recursive self-improvement.

items.title_zh: KULTURE Bench：评估语言模型韩国文化语境理解的新基准
items.title_en: KULTURE Bench: A Benchmark for Assessing Language Model in Korean Cultural Context
items.summary_zh: 研究者提出 KULTURE Bench，一个专门面向韩国文化的语言模型评测框架。论文指出，大模型在多项任务上表现大幅提升，但其输出愈发流畅连贯，反而让评测变得困难。当前多语言基准常直接使用英文版本翻译，可能夹带西方文化偏见，无法准确衡量其他语言与文化下的能力。KULTURE Bench 由此构建了文化相关的数据集，用于更贴近本土语境地检验模型表现。摘要未披露具体数据规模与实验得分。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2412.07251v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models have exhibited significant enhancements in performance across various tasks. However, the complexity of their evaluation increases as these models generate more fluent and coherent content. Current multilingual benchmarks often use translated English versions, which may incorporate Western cultural biases that do not accurately assess other languages and cultures. To address this research gap, we introduce KULTURE Bench, an evaluation framework specifically designed for Korean culture that features datasets of cultural new…
items.why_zh: 多语言评测长期依赖英文翻译版本，该基准提醒人们文化偏见会扭曲对非西方语言模型能力的判断。
items.why_en: Multilingual evaluation has long relied on translated English benchmarks; this work highlights how cultural bias distorts assessments of models in non-Western languages.

items.title_zh: “一个模型不够用”：人们如何在日常生活中同时使用多个 AI 模型
items.title_en: One Is Not Enough: How People Use Multiple AI Models in Everyday Life
items.summary_zh: 论文关注一个日益普遍的现象：人们同时使用多个多模态大模型（MLLM），并依据各自“ perceived 强项”挑选使用。这种跨平台实践带来新的协调成本——需要为不同界面改写提示词、在行为不一致时校准信任，还要分别管理各平台的对话历史。作者指出，以往人机交互（HCI）研究多聚焦单一智能体交互，对多 MLLM 协同编排研究不足。该研究通过日记研究与半结构化访谈（N=10）考察个体如何跨模型组织工作。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.26107v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: People increasingly use multiple Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) concurrently, selecting each based on its perceived strengths. This cross-platform practice creates coordination challenges: adapting prompts to different interfaces, calibrating trust against inconsistent behaviors, and navigating separate conversation histories. Prior HCI research focused on single-agent interactions, leaving multi-MLLM orchestration underexplored. Through a diary study and semi-structured interviews (N=10), we examine how individuals organize work acro…
items.why_zh: 多模型并用正在成为日常习惯，理解其中的协调成本有助于设计更好的跨模型工具与交互方式。
items.why_en: Using several models at once is becoming routine; understanding its coordination costs can inform better cross-model tools and interfaces.

items.title_zh: 实时聊天机器人：识别“浪漫诈骗”并判定所处阶段
items.title_en: Real-time Chatbot Romance Scam Detection in Stage Classification
items.summary_zh: 针对社交媒体上日益严重的浪漫诈骗（romance scam），研究者开发了一个可实时检测的聊天机器人，通过 Line Messaging API 接入对话。该研究借助社会科学领域已有的“七阶段”理论，用大语言模型判断对话处于浪漫诈骗的哪个阶段；一旦检出，聊天机器人还会通过大模型给出该阶段的解释与防范建议。作者称其贡献在于把阶段化理论与实时检测结合，帮助用户在受骗过程中及时获得提醒。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20631v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Romance scam has become a serious problem via social media, and the improvement of artificial intelligence enable to fake identify easily. In the study, a chatbot has developed to detect romance scam in real-time through Line Messaging API. Using the seven stage theories in the social science field, the stages of romance scam can be detected through large language model. In addition, once a romance scam is detected, the chatbot provides explanations of the stage and prevention advices through large language model. The contribution of the work p…
items.why_zh: 把诈骗的阶段化理论落到实时对话检测上，有望在受害者投入感情与金钱的过程中提前介入。
items.why_en: Grounding staged scam theory in real-time conversation detection could enable earlier intervention while victims are still emotionally and financially involved.

items.title_zh: 探索排列扩散语言模型的设计空间
items.title_en: Exploring the Design Space of Permutation Diffusion LLMs
items.summary_zh: 论文研究用语言模型做“排列生成”的问题：既需要依据文本条件排序，又需要在候选与输出位置之间建立全局一一对应。作者从三条技术路线考察扩散语言模型的参数化方式：对打乱后的候选索引序列做硬分配预测、在双随机矩阵上做软分配预测，以及直接预测排序分数再排序。这三类方法把排列约束放在预测与解码的不同阶段，因而支持不同的训练与推理方式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20635v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Permutation generation with language models requires both text-conditioned ranking and a global one-to-one assignment between candidates and output positions. We study this problem through three diffusion-LLM parameterizations: hard-assignment prediction over shuffled candidate-index sequences, soft-assignment prediction over doubly stochastic matrices, and direct ordering-score prediction followed by sorting. The three families place permutation constraints at different stages of prediction and decoding and therefore support different training…
items.why_zh: 排列生成本质上比逐词生成更难，厘清不同参数化方式为扩散式语言模型拓展任务边界。
items.why_en: Permutation generation is harder than token-by-token output, and mapping the parameterization space extends what diffusion-based language models can do.

items.title_zh: ImpactBench：评估生成式 AI 对人类影响的开放基准平台
items.title_en: Open Benchmark of AI Impact on Humans (ImpactBench): an expert-guided, open platform for the holistic evaluation of AI impact on humans
items.summary_zh: 研究者提出 ImpactBench（Open Benchmark of AI Impact on Humans），目标是在规模上测量生成式 AI 模型对使用者的多维影响。该平台由专家指导、可持续迭代，评估模型行为在心理、生理与社会三个维度上是支持还是损害个体福祉。ImpactBench 把领域专家提出的构念与既有基准转化为指标，并让这些指标扎根于模型的实际行为表现，而非仅停留在抽象问卷层面。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20690v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The present work is concerned with how to measure, at scale, the multi-dimensional impact of generative AI models on the individuals who use them. In service of this goal, we introduce the Open Benchmark of AI Impact on Humans, or ImpactBench. Our iterable and expert-guided platform evaluates whether model behaviors support or undermine an individual's wellbeing across psychological, physical, and social domains. ImpactBench translates constructs from domain experts and existing benchmarks into metrics that are grounded in actual model behavior…
items.why_zh: 把“AI 对人的影响”变成可规模化、可比较的测量，弥补当前基准只看任务能力不看人类福祉的空白。
items.why_en: Making AI's human impact measurable at scale fills a gap left by benchmarks that score task ability but not human wellbeing.

items.title_zh: 面向沃洛夫语的工业级开放权重语言模型
items.title_en: Wolof-Adapted Industry-Ready Open-Weight Language Models
items.summary_zh: 沃洛夫语（Wolof）约有 2300 万使用者，主要集中在塞内加尔，但开放权重模型对其支持仍然薄弱，而调用 API 模型又带来成本、治理与数据主权方面的限制。为此，研究者发布了 0.6B 至 14B 的开放权重模型，通过指令微调、偏好对齐与模型合并适配沃洛夫语。作者同时公开了流程与数据，并在 63 个公开及内部任务上做了大量实验，结果显示模型在沃洛夫语理解与生成上表现良好，同时在其他语言与跨语言场景中依然有效。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20824v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Wolof is spoken by 23M people, mostly in Senegal, but remains weakly supported by open-weight language models, while API models raise cost, governance, and sovereignty constraints for local deployments. In this paper, we present 0.6B-14B open-weight models adapted to Wolof through instruction tuning, preference alignment, and model merging. After presenting the pipeline and data, extensive experiments on 63~public and in-house tasks show good performance on Wolof understanding and generation while remaining effective on other languages and cros…
items.why_zh: 为低资源语言提供可本地部署的开放权重模型，直接回应成本与数据主权问题，而非依赖外部 API。
items.why_en: Locally deployable open-weight models for a low-resource language address cost and data-sovereignty concerns that API dependence creates.

items.title_zh: 在推理型大模型中摊销序贯实验设计
items.title_en: Amortizing Sequential Experimental Design in Reasoning LLMs
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，尽管大语言模型拥有大量预训练知识和较强推理能力，但在实验设计任务中仍难以自适应地采集信息。作者研究如何把序贯贝叶斯实验设计（BED）摊销进 LLM：用信息增益作为奖励，显式训练引导动作选择的推理过程。其方法将实验的生成模型与 LLM 自身信念解耦，从而可以在自选模型下优化期望信息增益，而不是受限于模型内置的直觉判断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20832v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Despite their extensive pretraining knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, large language models (LLMs) struggle to adaptively gather information in experimental design tasks. We study how to amortize sequential Bayesian experimental design (BED) into an LLM by explicitly training the reasoning that guides action selection using information-gain rewards. Our approach specifies the experimental generative model independently of the LLM's own beliefs, allowing us to optimize expected information gain under a model of our choosing. We invest…
items.why_zh: 让模型学会“下一步该做什么实验”，是把 LLM 推向真实科学发现流程的关键能力。
items.why_en: Teaching models to decide which experiment to run next is a key capability for moving LLMs into real scientific discovery workflows.

items.title_zh: 错误的投票，正确的梯度：为何多数投票奖励能媲美可验证奖励强化学习
items.title_en: Wrong Votes, Right Gradients: Why Majority-Vote Rewards Track Verifiable RL
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文试图解释一个反直觉现象：用模型自身多次采样后多数投票产生的标签做强化学习，往往能取得接近“可验证奖励”训练的效果。作者指出，若从单个提示（prompt）层面看，多数投票只返回模型的众数答案，无法提供关于正确性的新信息，因此这一效果难以理解。他们主张真正的分析单位应是批次级更新：由于参数共享，在实际批次规模下，某个提示自身的梯度对该提示输出变化的贡献不足 1%，所以即使标签错误，批量更新仍可能把模型推向正确方向。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20898v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning with self-generated labels, such as majority vote over a model's own samples, often recovers most of the gain of training with verifiable rewards. This is puzzling from the usual prompt-level view, in which majority vote only returns a model's modal answer and cannot add information about correctness. We argue that the relevant unit is the batch-level update. Because parameters are shared, a prompt's own gradient accounts for less than 1\% of the change in that prompt's output at practical batch sizes, so a wrong label ma…
items.why_zh: 它给出了一个可解释的机制，说明为何无需昂贵的人工或程序化验证标签，也能用自生成标签进行有效的强化学习。
items.why_en: It offers a mechanistic explanation for why self-generated labels can substitute for expensive verifiable rewards in RL training.

items.title_zh: 可复现的对偶赌博机算法
items.title_en: Replicable Dueling Bandits
items.summary_zh: 论文研究“可复现的对偶赌博机（dueling bandits）”：在同一偏好下运行两次，若共享内部随机性、但比较结果相互独立，则每一轮都必须以至少 1-ρ 的概率选出相同的有序臂对。由于对偶赌博机每轮比较都依赖此前的带噪结果，两次运行的比较路径可能完全不同，因此可复现性是一个非平凡的约束。作者在 Beat-the-Mean 的基础上（其分数随臂被淘汰而变化，且不必把最优臂排在最高）设计了首批兼具可复现性与次线性遗憾的算法，并在放松的随机传递性条件下进行分析。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20908v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dueling bandits choose each comparison based on earlier noisy outcomes, so two runs on the same preferences can compare different pairs. We study replicable dueling bandits, where two executions with shared internal randomness and independent comparison outcomes must select the same ordered pair in every round with probability at least $1-\rho$. Building on Beat-the-Mean, whose scores change as arms are eliminated and need not rank the best arm highest, we design the first such algorithms with sublinear regret. Under relaxed stochastic transiti…
items.why_zh: 它首次把“可复现性”引入对偶赌博机，为需要结果可重复的在线比较与推荐系统提供了理论保证的算法。
items.why_en: It brings replicability guarantees to dueling bandits for the first time, offering provable algorithms for online comparison and recommendation settings where reproducible results matter.

items.title_zh: EigDiff：用特征样本训练扩散模型，大幅缩减训练数据集
items.title_en: EigDiff: Eigensample Diffusion - or how to significantly reduce training dataset size with marginal performance variation?
items.summary_zh: 扩散模型训练代价高昂，通常需要大规模数据集来学习如何在多个细小去噪步骤中逐步逆转图像噪声。现有方法多聚焦于蒸馏去噪步数，却忽视了训练数据本身可能存在的冗余。论文提出 EigDiff，探索利用特征样本（eigensamples）在显著更小的数据集上训练扩散模型，同时保持模型性能。为缓解特征图像对仿射变换的敏感性，作者还引入了相应的处理手段。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20999v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Diffusion models are notoriously expensive to train, requiring large-scale datasets to learn how to gradually reverse the noise from images over multiple small denoising steps. Current approaches focus on distilling the number of diffusion steps, neglecting potential redundancies of the training data. In this paper, we explore the potential of harnessing eigensamples to train diffusion models on significantly smaller datasets, while preserving model performance. To mitigate the sensitivity to affine transformations of eigenimages, we harness th…
items.why_zh: 若能大幅压缩扩散模型的训练数据规模而性能几乎不降，将直接降低训练成本与数据需求。
items.why_en: Substantially shrinking diffusion training data with little performance loss could directly cut training costs and data requirements.

items.title_zh: 学会读出：语言模型预训练中的 Unembedding 动态
items.title_en: Learning to Read Out: Unembedding Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
items.summary_zh: 语言模型在什么时候真正获得某项能力？以往的发展性研究通常以模型开始输出正确 token 的时间点来判断。但预测结果要经过 unembedding（读出）矩阵，而这个矩阵本身在预训练过程中仍在不断学习，因此从输出端读到的时间线会把“模型编码了什么”与“读出层表达了什么”混在一起。作者表明，隐藏状态可以在读出层尚未表达之前就已编码任务信息，并提出基于参数轨迹的 crosscoder 方法，直接追踪读出层的演化。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21025v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: When does a language model acquire a capability? Developmental studies usually answer this by tracking when models start producing the correct token. But that prediction passes through the unembedding matrix, or readout, which is itself still being learned during pretraining. We show that a model's hidden states can encode task information before its own readout expresses it, so timelines read from outputs conflate what the model encodes with what its readout expresses. To track the readout directly, we introduce parameter-trajectory crosscodin…
items.why_zh: 它指出仅凭输出判断能力出现时间会产生系统性偏差，为研究模型能力涌现提供了更准确的观测工具。
items.why_en: It shows that output-based timelines conflate encoding with readout, offering a more accurate lens on when capabilities actually emerge.
